spell_catalog.title: 114B ACKS Players Companion Spell Catalog F-U
spell_catalog.section: spell entries and ritual spell index

effects.summary: Grants prophetic insight into a particular character's future.
effects.effect: Reveals a general indication of the target's fate; exact date and place are not provided.
No character may have more than one fate at a time.

procedure.step: Judge determines the fate or rolls on the fate table.
Apply the revealed fate to the target character until fulfilled or otherwise nullified.

row.answer: You shall set your eyes on the heavens; time enough for the earth in the grave.
You shall be anointed, before you die, as one who walked among the high.
You shall have, in the end, many true vassals, but one false friend.
Your many victories shall be won at the cost of many a woman's son.
Precious jewels shall buy you only tools and fools.
When the battle is won, a great lord shall be undone.
By steel you shall lead, and by steel you shall bleed.
Reap what you have sown; blood, sorrow, or throne.
You shall be remembered for your deeds, or for your greeds.
The world shall lie at your feet until the day of your defeat.

special.rule: Fate is not entirely unalterable; gross stupidity, recklessness, suicide, or willful avoidance may still prevent ordinary fulfillment.
In most cases the fate is fulfilled, even if only poetically or at the moment of death.
Divine access restricted to Priestess, Shaman, and Witch.

spell.name: Fear
spell.area: 60' long, 30' wide cone from the caster's hands

effects.summary: Forces creatures in a cone to flee.
effects.condition_effect: Creatures that fail the save flee from the caster at running speed for 30 rounds.

special.rule: Used to create wands of fear.
Divine access restricted to Priestess and Witch.

effects.summary: Senses the most valuable treasure within range.
effects.effect: After concentrating for 1 turn, the caster senses the direction and distance of the most valuable treasure within 360'.

limits.limit: Treasure must be worth at least 50gp total to be detected.
Magical wards and lead block detection.

special.rule: Physical barriers other than magical wards or lead do not impede detection.
Used to create potions of treasure finding.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 3rd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Transforms the subject into a translucent cloud of gas.
effects.effect: Everything carried or worn immediately falls to the floor.
The gaseous subject cannot attack.
Can flow below doors and through other small spaces that are not sealed airtight.
Has AC 11.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed if the target is unwilling.

special.rule: Used to create potions of gaseous form.

effects.summary: Temporarily grants the strength of a hill giant.
effects.effect: Recipient attacks as an 8 HD monster or as his own class and level, whichever is better.
effects.damage: Recipient inflicts double normal damage with attacks.
effects.attack: Recipient can throw rocks to 200' for 3d6 damage.

limits.limit: Does not combine with other magical effects that influence Strength.

interactions.rule: Stacks with the character's normal Strength bonus or penalty.
interactions.result: A weak recipient has the strength of a weak giant; a very strong recipient has the strength of a very strong giant.

special.rule: Used to create girdles of giant strength and potions of giant strength.

effects.summary: Covers the area in glowing dust that blinds and outlines hidden creatures.
effects.condition_effect: Creatures that fail the save are blinded for the duration.
effects.effect: Invisible or hidden creatures in the area are visibly outlined.
Outlined creatures cannot thereafter benefit from invisibility or hiding in shadows while the glitterdust remains.

duration_rules.rule: The glitterdust cannot be removed.
It vanishes when the duration expires or if dispelled.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Sylvan Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to minor globe of invulnerability, except it blocks spells and spell effects of up to 4th level.
Doubles the recipient's size.
effects.damage: Recipient deals double normal damage with attacks.
effects.effect: Attack throws do not improve because increased strength is offset by unfamiliarity with giant size.

limits.limit: Strength bonus does not combine with other magical effects that influence Strength.

interactions.rule: Stacks with the character's normal Strength bonus or penalty.
If a creature under growth is subjected to diminution, or vice versa, both spells are cancelled.

reversed_form.name: diminution

effects.summary: Shrinks the target and everything carried to 6 inches tall.
effects.effect: If the diminished character remains motionless, he can avoid being spotted with a proficiency throw of 3+ on 1d20.
effects.damage: The character deals normal damage only to opponents smaller than 1'; larger opponents take only 1 point of damage from any successful hit.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed if the target is unwilling.

reversed_form.special: Used to create potions of diminution.

special.rule: Used to create potions of growth.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 4th level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

spell.name: Gust of Wind
spell.area: 10' wide, 60' long line from the caster

effects.summary: Creates a strong blast of air with size-based effects.
effects.effect: Tiny creatures are knocked down and rolled 1d4x10', taking 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10'.
Flying tiny or smaller creatures are blown back 2d6x10' and take 2d6 nonlethal damage.
Small creatures are knocked prone, or if flying are blown back 1d6x10'.
Man-sized creatures cannot move forward against the wind, or if flying are blown back 1d6x5'.
Creatures of ogre size or larger move normally within the gust.
effects.penalty: -4 to missile attack throws within or through the gust.
-4 to proficiency throws to hear noise within or through the gust.

interactions.rule: Automatically extinguishes candles, torches, and other unprotected flames.
Protected flames such as lanterns have a 50% chance of being extinguished.
Can fan large fires, overturn delicate awnings, create dust spray, or blow vapors out of range, at Judge's discretion.

effects.summary: Mesmerizes creatures that see the pattern.
effects.condition_effect: Affected creatures stand motionless and take no action, even to defend themselves.

limits.limit: Can mesmerize a maximum of 24 total Hit Dice or levels.
Creatures with the fewest HD are affected first.
Lasts only while the caster remains stationary and concentrates.

effects.summary: Makes the target move and fight noiselessly.
effects.effect: Items carried or picked up by the recipient also become noiseless while in the recipient's possession.
Items leaving the recipient's possession regain normal audibility if fired, dropped, or put down.

duration_rules.rule: Ends if the recipient speaks, suffers damage, fails a saving throw, or casts a spell.
Merely attacking or interacting with objects does not end the effect.
Maximum duration is 24 hours.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 3rd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Protects the caster from normal, non-magical attacks by evil creatures.
effects.effect: Magic or silver weapons can still harm the caster.
Any number of normal swords, arrows, clubs, or natural weapons wielded by evil creatures are fended off.
Evil monsters affected only by silver or magical weapons can still harm the subject.
Evil monsters with 5 HD or more can affect the subject through natural ferocity.

limits.limit: For this spell, evil creatures include hostile creatures of an alignment other than the caster's, undead, and summoned creatures of Chaotic alignment.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Bladedancer.

effects.summary: Grants prodigious leaping ability.
effects.movement: May leap 10' vertically and 30' horizontally from a standing start.
effects.effect: Recipient needs no rest if engaged in ordinary movement.

special.rule: Used to create boots of traveling and springing.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Reveals the direction to the closest specimen of a named animal or plant type within range.
effects.effect: If no specimen is currently within range, the caster learns that instead.
If a specimen later comes into range during the duration, the caster learns its direction at that time.
effects.bonus: +4 on Naturalism proficiency throws to locate poisonous plants.

targets.requirement: Caster must name a specific type of animal or plant.
targets.invalid_target: Fantastic creatures such as owlbears or wyverns.

saving_throw.rule: Animal or plant gets no saving throw.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman and Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 6th level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess.

targets.requirement: Target carpet, rug, or tapestry must be at least 4' x 6' and no larger than 10' x 15'.

effects.summary: Transforms a suitable carpet into a flying vehicle under the caster's command.
effects.effect: Controlling the carpet requires as much concentration as riding a horse.
effects.movement: With one human-sized passenger, movement is 300' per turn.
With two human-sized passengers, movement is 240' per turn.
With three human-sized passengers, movement is 180' per turn.

limits.limit: No more than three human-sized creatures or 60 stone total may be carried.

interactions.rule: If the spell is dispelled, the carpet and its passengers plummet from the air.

special.rule: Used to create flying carpets.
Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 1st level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification and range as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

targets.requirement: Rope must be at least finger-thick and in reasonable condition.
A creature must hold one end when the magic is invoked.

effects.summary: Enchants rope to move on command and support heavy loads.
effects.effect: Supports 100 stone (1,000lb) regardless of normal carrying capacity.
effects.movement: Moves at 10' per round in any directed path and can fasten itself securely where directed.
effects.effect: Can unfasten itself and return in the same manner.

special.rule: Used to create ropes of climbing.

effects.summary: Grants multiple subjects infravision to 60'.

scaling.rule: Affects one subject, plus one subject per two caster levels beyond 1st.
Affects five subjects at 9th level, six subjects at 11th level, and a maximum of seven subjects at 13th level.

effects.summary: Prevents 1st, 2nd, and 3rd level spells or spell effects from penetrating the globe.
effects.effect: Areas of effect of such spells exclude the protected area.
4th level and higher spells are unaffected.
Spells cast outward from within the globe pass through it freely.

interactions.rule: Can be destroyed by dispel magic.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Imbues the caster with necromantic power and temporary hit points.
effects.healing: Grants 1d10 temporary hit points +1 hp per caster level.
effects.effect: Temporary hit points are lost first if damage is suffered.
While active, the caster is treated as an inherently evil summoned creature for detect evil and protection from evil effects.

duration_rules.rule: Temporary hit points cannot be regained through rest or healing magic.
Temporary hit points disappear when the duration expires.

interactions.rule: A dispel evil or dispel magic strips the caster of the temporary hit points unless the caster succeeds on a save versus Spells.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed to keep temporary hit points against dispel evil or dispel magic.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Chthonic Witch.

effects.summary: Protects the target from crystal balls and any type of ESP.
effects.effect: Protection also prevents a crystal ball from spying on items the recipient is wearing and on the recipient's present location.
An attempt to spy reveals only that the target is magically protected.

special.rule: Used to create amulets versus crystal balls and ESP.
Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Condemns the touched creature to oblivion if it fails its save.
effects.effect: On failure, the creature vanishes and cannot return except by wish or miracle.
Rescued characters are insane for 3d4 weeks after return.

spell.name: Obscuring Cloud
spell.area: Billowing cloud 1' high and 10' in diameter per caster level

effects.summary: Creates a harmless mist that blocks line of sight for most creatures.
effects.effect: The caster and creatures able to see invisible can see dimly through the cloud.
All others within the cloud are effectively blind.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman and Sylvan Witch.

effects.summary: Grants the strength and prowess of an ogre.
effects.effect: Recipient has effective Strength 18.
effects.bonus: +3 to attack throws and damage rolls and other benefits of Strength 18.
effects.effect: Can carry an extra 10 stone.

special.rule: Used to create gauntlets of ogre power.

spell.name: Panic
spell.area: All creatures within 240' except those inside a 10' radius safe zone

effects.summary: Causes affected creatures to flee in fear.
effects.condition_effect: Failed targets flee at running speed for 30 rounds.

special.rule: Used to create drums of panic.

effects.summary: Allows the recipient to move without leaving evidence of passage.
effects.effect: Works across fresh snow, brush, and similar surfaces without leaving normal traces.

interactions.rule: Detect magic or true seeing cast within three turns reveals the recipient's passage.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman.

effects.summary: Creates a permanent multi-sensory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
effects.effect: Includes visual, auditory, olfactory, and thermal components.
Can be static or dynamic.
Dynamic illusions are non-interactive and repeat every round.
Those who successfully disbelieve see a translucent outline.

saving_throw.rule: Successful disbelief shows the illusion as a translucent outline.
Successful saves also avoid all illusory damage.

duration_rules.rule: Lasts until dispelled.
Creatures apparently killed or injured realize they are unharmed after 1d6 rounds.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 2nd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Creates an illusion of the target's greatest fear that attacks the target.
effects.attack: Attacks once per round after creation, rolling to hit as a 4 HD monster.
effects.condition_effect: If it scores even one successful attack throw, the target dies of fright.
effects.effect: The killer is invulnerable to attacks and can pass through any barriers.
Only the caster and the target can see it.
Others cannot assist the target in disbelieving.

saving_throw.rule: The target gets one chance to disbelieve.

limits.limit: Only defenses are disbelieving it, incapacitating the caster, or avoiding being hit for the duration.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 4th level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Accurately predicts the weather within range for the next 12 hours.

limits.limit: Provides foreknowledge only; does not control the weather.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman and Witch.

effects.summary: Creates a small flame in the caster's palm.
effects.effect: The flame is harmless to the caster and sheds light like a normal torch.
Touching combustible materials ignites them without extinguishing the magical flame.
effects.attack: The flame may be thrown to 30'; it disappears 1 round after leaving the caster's hand.
effects.effect: The caster may make the flame disappear and reappear by concentration once per round.
Other items may be held and used in the hand while the fire is out.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman.

spell.name: Programmed Illusion
spell.area: 40' x 40' x 40' illusion placed on an area or object

targets.requirement: Must be placed upon a particular area or object.

effects.summary: Places a spectral-force style multi-sensory illusion that activates on a specified trigger.
effects.effect: Can be static or dynamic.
Dynamic sequences are non-interactive.
Dynamic sequences cannot exceed 1 round per caster level.
Those who successfully disbelieve see a translucent outline.

saving_throw.rule: Successful disbelief shows the illusion as a translucent outline.
Successful saves also avoid all illusory damage.

duration_rules.rule: After triggering, the illusion lasts until dispelled or until a maximum of 1 round per caster level elapses.
Creatures apparently killed or injured realize they are unharmed after 1d6 rounds.

limits.limit: Only visual and audible triggers can be used.
Cannot distinguish level, Hit Dice, or class except by external garb.

interactions.rule: Triggers react to appearances; disguises and illusions can fool them.
Normal darkness does not defeat a visual trigger, but magical darkness or invisibility does.
Silent movement or magical silence defeats audible triggers.
Audible triggers can key on general noises, specific noises, spoken words, or visible or audible actions.
Trigger range is 10' per caster level and only to visible or audible events within line of sight or hearing distance.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 3rd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess.

effects.summary: Completely protects the subject from normal, non-magical attacks.
effects.effect: Magic or silver weapons can still harm the subject.
Any number of normal swords, arrows, clubs, or natural weapons are fended off.
Monsters that themselves can only be affected by silver or magical weapons can still harm the subject.
Monsters with 5 HD or more can affect the subject through natural ferocity.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess.

effects.summary: Makes contaminated food and water suitable for eating and drinking.
effects.effect: Purifies one ration of food, 6 skins of water, or enough normal food to feed a dozen people.

limits.limit: Does not prevent later natural decay or spoilage.
Has no effect on creatures or on magic potions.

interactions.rule: Unholy water and similar significant food or drink are spoiled by this spell.

effects.summary: Spoils one ration of food, 6 skins of water, or enough normal food to feed a dozen people.
effects.condition_effect: Anyone consuming the spoiled food or water is violently ill for 2 hours (12 turns), able to do nothing but retch and heave.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 1st level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 6th level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman.

effects.summary: Imbues subjects with righteous wrath against enemies of the faith.
effects.effect: Subjects cannot retreat from combat once it has begun.

scaling.rule: Affects one creature initially, one additional creature at 6th level, and another at 11th level.

duration_rules.rule: Ends when combat ends or when 1 turn elapses, whichever comes first.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Cleric.

effects.summary: Improves healing during complete rest.
effects.healing: Subject heals an extra 1d3 hit points during each day of complete rest.

duration_rules.rule: Ends if the subject stops completely resting or takes any damage.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess and Witch.

spell.name: Scouring Wind
spell.area: 10' wide, 60' long line from the caster

effects.summary: Creates a damaging blast of wind and debris with additional size-based effects.
effects.damage: Creatures in the area take 1d4 damage per caster level from abrasion and debris.
effects.effect: Tiny creatures that fail the save are knocked down and rolled 1d4x10', taking 1d4 nonlethal damage per 10'.
Flying tiny or smaller creatures that fail the save are blown back 2d6x10' and take 2d6 nonlethal damage.
Small creatures that fail the save are knocked prone, or if flying are blown back 1d6x10'.
Man-sized creatures that fail the save cannot move forward against the wind, or if flying are blown back 1d6x5'.
Creatures of ogre size or larger move normally within the wind.
effects.penalty: -4 to missile attack throws within or through the wind.
-4 to proficiency throws to hear noise within or through the wind.

saving_throw.partial: Half damage on success; save failure is required for the additional size-based effects.

interactions.rule: Automatically extinguishes candles, torches, and other unprotected flames.
Protected flames such as lanterns have a 50% chance of being extinguished.
Can fan large fires, overturn delicate awnings, create dust spray, or blow vapors out of range, at Judge's discretion.

targets.requirement: Caster must have access to a mirror, crystal, reflective pool, or other surface to display the images.

effects.summary: Shows images of distant creatures, objects, or places.
effects.effect: Images are clearer the more familiar the caster is with the subject viewed.

duration_rules.rule: Each use lasts up to 1 turn.
The caster must fully concentrate and remain stationary.

interactions.rule: Clairaudience can be cast with scry to hear sounds and conversations at the location viewed.
ESP can be cast with scry to hear the thoughts of one observed creature.

limits.limit: The caster cannot otherwise cast spells at or communicate with what is viewed.

special.rule: Used to create crystal balls.
Divine access restricted to Priestess and Witch.

targets.target: Blade of an edged or pointed weapon

effects.summary: Temporarily enhances the weapon to the equivalent of a magic weapon +1.
effects.effect: Weapons already enchanted gain an additional +1 while the spell lasts.
One casting affects 20 arrows, 2 one-handed weapons, or 1 two-handed weapon.

special.rule: Used to create oil of sharpness.

effects.summary: Allows the touched character to move almost noiselessly.
effects.bonus: +8 to proficiency throws to move silently.
effects.effect: Characters affected can always move silently with a throw of at least 12+.

special.rule: Used to create elven boots.
Divine access restricted to Sylvan Witch.

effects.summary: Allows the caster to assume the form of a normal or giant animal.
effects.effect: Gains the physical capabilities, physical attacks, special abilities, and statistics of the assumed animal form.
Retains own mental abilities.
Can change to a new animal form each round.
If slain, reverts to original form.

duration_rules.rule: Caster can continue changing forms freely until reverting to original form or the duration expires.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 1st level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Makes a character, object, or floor nearly impossible to grasp or stand on.
effects.effect: Affected characters cannot be restrained or grabbed by grasping attacks, including ropes, chains, cuffs, or constricting creatures, magical or otherwise.
One casting affects 20 arrows, 2 one-handed weapons, 1 two-handed weapon, or one 10' x 10' floor patch.
Characters must make an attack throw vs AC 10 each round to grab or keep hold of affected objects.
Anyone moving or even standing on an affected floor must make a proficiency throw of 20+ each round or fall down.

special.rule: Used to create oil of slipperiness.

effects.summary: Creates a movable multi-sensory illusion of an object, creature, or force.
effects.effect: Includes visual, auditory, olfactory, tactile, and thermal components.
The caster can move the image within the effect's size limits.
If the illusion depicts creatures, they have AC 0 and disappear if hit in combat.
effects.damage: If used to simulate an attack spell or attacking creature, illusory damage equals the normal damage for the simulated attack form.

saving_throw.rule: Successful saves avoid all illusory damage.

duration_rules.rule: The image persists while the caster concentrates and for 3 rounds afterward.
Those apparently killed or injured realize they are unharmed after 1d6 rounds.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Prepares an item to hold up to six spells.
effects.effect: Only the caster of spell storing may store spells in the item.
Any character who puts the item on automatically knows which spells are stored and may discharge them.
Stored spells are discharged as if cast by a spellcaster of the minimum level required to cast each spell.

procedure.step: Cast spell storing on the item.
Within 1 turn, cast each spell to be stored into the item, one at a time.
Any wearer may later discharge the stored spells until they expire or are used.

limits.limit: Maximum of six stored spells.

duration_rules.rule: Stored spells remain until discharged or until one day passes, whichever comes first.

special.rule: Used to create rings of spell storing.

spell.name: Sphere of Visibility
spell.area: Sphere with radius 5' per caster level

effects.summary: Negates invisibility within the sphere.
effects.effect: Anything invisible becomes visible while in the area.

limits.limit: Does not necessarily reveal creatures obscured by cover, darkness, or similar concealment.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess.

effects.summary: Allows the recipient to climb vertical surfaces and hang from ceilings.
effects.effect: Needs no climbing gear or handholds.
Can attack with a one-handed weapon, cast spells, and defend normally while climbing.

limits.limit: At least three limbs must be free to spider climb.
Cannot charge or run while climbing.

effects.summary: Creates a healing force the caster directs each round.
effects.healing: Heals a creature within 60' of 1d6+1 damage each round.
effects.effect: The spirit can continue healing the same creature or be directed to another creature on subsequent rounds.
May cure paralysis instead of curing any points of damage.
Cannot increase hit points above the creature's normal maximum.

duration_rules.rule: The caster must concentrate for the duration.
If concentration is lost, the spirit vanishes and the spell ends.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Priestess.

effects.summary: Creates foul vapors that render creatures helpless with nausea.
effects.condition_effect: Failed targets are helpless due to nausea.

saving_throw.rule: Creatures entering or remaining in the cloud must save.

duration_rules.rule: Nausea lasts while the creature remains in the cloud and for 1d4+1 rounds after leaving.
A creature that succeeds on its save but remains in the cloud must continue saving each round.

effects.summary: Summons normal animals within range to aid the caster.
effects.effect: Animals arrive at their fastest movement rate.
For the duration, summoned animals understand the spellcaster's speech and help as best they can.
Summoned animals usually flee if harmed.
If the caster is under attack when an animal arrives, it immediately attacks the caster's opponent.
Can calm and befriend hostile wildlife already present by effectively 'summoning' them.

scaling.rule: Responding animals may total up to the caster's level in Hit Dice.

limits.limit: Affects only normal animals.
Does not affect fantastic creatures, giant-sized animals, humanoids, or vermin such as insects or oozes.

special.rule: Treat normal small creatures such as birds, hares, and squirrels as swarms.
Divine access restricted to Shaman and Sylvan Witch.

effects.summary: Summons 4 berserkers to fight for the caster.
effects.effect: Berserkers appear anywhere within range.
Berserkers are completely loyal.

duration_rules.rule: Persist until slain, dispelled, or until 3 turns elapse.

effects.summary: Summons a djinni to serve and obey the summoner.
effects.effect: The djinni appears anywhere within range.

duration_rules.rule: Serves for 1 day, until slain, or until dispelled.

limits.limit: May be performed safely only once per week.
If cast sooner, the summoned djinni is hostile and immediately attacks.

special.rule: Used to create rings of djinni calling.

effects.summary: Summons a specified fantastic creature to the caster's service.
effects.effect: The creature appears anywhere within range and serves and obeys the summoner.

targets.valid_target: Any similar fantastic creature of 10 HD or less with one or fewer special abilities

duration_rules.rule: Persists until the creature is slain, dispelled, or until 6 turns elapse.

effects.summary: Summons a 4th level fighter hero from another sphere of existence to serve the caster.
effects.effect: The hero is completely loyal and can fight, guard, open doors, and perform other heroic tasks.

special.rule: Hero statistics: AC 8, Move 90', F4, hp 20, #AT 1, +1 to attack throws, Dmg 1d6+4, SV F4, ML 12, AL N, +1 initiative.
Hero is armed with sword +1, shield, and plate armor.
Persists until slain, dispelled, or until 3 turns elapse.
The hero's magic sword and other equipment disappear when the hero disappears.

effects.summary: Pulls a nearby weather condition to the caster's location.

limits.limit: The caster summons weather but does not control it.

scaling.rule: Range of summoning is 5 miles at level 7, plus 1 mile for each caster level above 7th.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman and Witch.

effects.summary: Calls a pegasus to serve as a winged steed.
effects.effect: The pegasus appears within range, tacked and saddled for riding.
The caster may ride it or command it to carry another creature.

limits.limit: The pegasus will submit to no more than one rider.
The spell does not grant Riding proficiency.

duration_rules.rule: Persists until the pegasus is slain, dispelled, or until 1 day passes.

effects.summary: Doubles the caster's normal attacks per round.
effects.effect: Movement is not accelerated.
Spellcasting is not accelerated.
Magic items such as wands may still be used only once per round.

limits.limit: Multiple speed effects do not combine; use only the most powerful or longest lasting effect.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Bladedancer.

effects.summary: Reads the thoughts of a creature within range and allows two-way telepathic communication with that creature.
effects.effect: The caster may send a telepathic message to anyone whose surface thoughts he is reading.

limits.limit: Requires full concentration; the caster may not move or take any action.

special.rule: Used to create helms of telepathy.
Divine access restricted to Witch.

targets.requirement: Target must be in its tomb, coffin, sarcophagus, ossuary, or other final resting place.

effects.summary: Puts an undead creature into indefinite pseudo-sleep.
effects.effect: Undead such as zombies, mummies, and liches do not decay while in torpor.
Hungering undead such as ghouls and vampires need not feed while in torpor.
An awakened undead may choose to return to torpor or remain awake after resolving the reason for awakening.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed if the target is unwilling.

duration_rules.rule: The undead awakens if its final resting place is disturbed.
The caster may set other awakening conditions, such as a particular alignment of the stars or outer planes.

effects.summary: Places the caster in a deep trance that detects specific supernatural presences.
effects.effect: Each round, the caster can detect the presence and location of one of the following within range: curses, incorporeal undead, permanent magical effects, sinkholes of evil, or summoned creatures.

limits.limit: While in trance, the caster cannot move, speak, or take any action.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman and Witch.

effects.summary: Grants troll-like regeneration.
effects.effect: If reduced below 0 hp, the caster continues to regenerate.
If the caster reaches 1 or more hp before expiration, no bed rest is needed.
Lost limbs or body parts from mortal wounds crawl back and instantly reattach if held to the stump.

limits.limit: Only damage taken while the spell is active can be regenerated.
Does not regenerate damage or mortal wounds suffered before the spell was cast.
Cannot regenerate damage caused by acid or fire.

targets.requirement: Target cannot weigh more in stones than the caster could physically lift.

effects.summary: Violently whirls a target through the air and lets the caster fling it.
effects.movement: Caster may mentally fling the target up to 20' per round in any direction.
effects.damage: If flung into a hard surface, the target takes 2d6 damage.
effects.effect: Grounded or surface-braced non-flyers move at half speed; otherwise they gyrate helplessly.
effects.penalty: Attacking while gyrating imposes cumulative penalties of -1 on the first attack throw, -2 on the second, and so on, to a maximum of -5.
effects.effect: A full round spent stabilizing resets the penalty progression to -1.
Targets able to fly move normally and suffer no attack penalties.

duration_rules.rule: The caster must concentrate to sustain the spell.
If concentration ends, the target usually plummets violently and takes additional damage as appropriate.

effects.summary: Creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless servant for simple tasks.
effects.effect: Can fetch items, open doors, hold chairs, clean, and perform similar simple tasks.
Performs only one activity at a time but continues that task until ordered otherwise or the spell expires.
Can carry up to 2 stone (20lb) or pull 4 stone (40lb) across a smooth surface.
Can trigger traps, but cannot activate pressure plates requiring more than 20 pounds of force.
Cannot fight.
effects.immunity: Cannot be harmed by normal attacks.

interactions.rule: Can be dispelled.
Can be dissipated by receiving 6 points of damage from area attacks.

limits.limit: If sent outside the spell's range, it dissipates instantly.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 1st level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Witch.

spell.name: Wall of Corpses
spell.area: Up to 1,200 square feet, shaped as desired

effects.summary: Conjures a durable wall of writhing animated corpses.
effects.condition_effect: Creatures that first see the wall and fail the save flee in terror for 30 rounds.
effects.attack: Creatures approaching within 5' are attacked each round as if by a zombie.
effects.effect: Wall has AC 4 and 2 Hit Dice per caster level.

limits.limit: Cannot be evoked where objects or creatures already are.

interactions.rule: Dispel magic or disintegrate destroys the wall immediately.
Can also be affected by normal or magical attacks, fire, cold, lightning, or other physical or magical effects.
A cleric may turn it as an Infernal creature; successful turning makes it an inert fleshy barrier for the duration of the turning.

spell.name: Wall of Force
spell.area: Up to 1,200 square feet, shaped as desired

effects.summary: Creates an invisible, impenetrable wall of force.

limits.limit: Cannot be evoked where objects or creatures already are.

interactions.rule: Unaffected by normal or magical attacks, fire, cold, lightning, or any other physical or magical effect.
Dispel magic does not affect it.
Disintegrate destroys it.

spell.name: Wall of Smoke
spell.area: Up to 1,000 square feet, shaped as desired

effects.summary: Creates an immobile opaque wall of smoke.
effects.effect: Impermeable to vision and light.
Presents no obstacle to movement.
Presents no obstacle to magical effects except those that require line of sight to target.

limits.limit: Cannot be evoked where objects or creatures already are.

interactions.rule: Water or strong winds affect it like ordinary smoke.
Disintegrate or dispel magic destroys it instantly.
Otherwise it dissipates in 1 turn.

spell.name: Wall of Wood
spell.area: Normally up to 1,200 square feet at 1" thickness

effects.summary: Brings a wooden wall into existence.
effects.effect: Wall is normally 1" thick.
Wall can be made thicker with proportionate reduction in area.
Wall cannot be made thinner than 1".
May be shaped almost any way the caster desires.
Need not be vertical, but must rest on a firm foundation.

limits.limit: Cannot be evoked where objects or creatures already are.

interactions.rule: Permanent unless destroyed or dispelled with dispel magic.
If used as a bridge or ramp, area is reduced by half.
Crude battlements and ramparts also reduce area.

effects.summary: Warps and bends wooden weapons, wands, and staffs.

scaling.rule: Affects one arrow or bolt per caster level.
A spear, javelin, or wand counts as 2 arrows.
A club, bow, or staff counts as 4 arrows.

limits.limit: Has no effect on wooden items other than weapons, wands, and staffs.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed for magical wooden items by the wielder.
saving_throw.modifier: +1 to the save for each charge or point of magical bonus the item possesses.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Shaman.

effects.summary: Equivalent to the 3rd level arcane spell of the same name, except for classification, range, and duration as listed here.

special.rule: Divine 3 access restricted to Shaman.
Divine 4 access restricted to Witch.

effects.summary: Allows the subject to walk on water as though it were solid dry land.
effects.effect: The subject can still attack creatures in or beneath the water's surface.

limits.limit: The subject cannot swim or submerge without ending the effect.

special.rule: Used to create rings of water walking.
Divine access restricted to Shaman and Priestess.

effects.summary: Grants the caster wings and flight.
effects.movement: Fly in any direction at 120' per round (360' per turn).
effects.effect: Requires only as much concentration as walking, so the caster can attack or cast spells normally.
The appearance of the wings is determined by alignment, deity, and spell signature.

limits.limit: The caster cannot carry aloft more than maximum load.

interactions.rule: If dispelled, the caster plummets from the air.

special.rule: Divine access restricted to Bladedancer and Shaman.

effects.summary: Allows the caster to see through solid material.
effects.effect: Can see through up to 30' of stone.
Can see through up to 60' of wood and other low-density material.
Can visually examine a 10' square area each turn.
Secret doors, hidden recesses, and traps in the examined area are evident.

limits.limit: Requires full concentration; the caster cannot move or take any other action.
Lead or gold blocks the vision.

special.rule: Used to create rings of x-ray vision.

effects.summary: Permanently removes all power from a magic item and makes it ordinary.

limits.limit: Normally does not affect artifacts or relics.
At Judge's discretion, artifacts or relics might be susceptible if special components of great rarity are used.

special.rule: Used to create rods of cancellation.

spell.name: Cataclysm
spell.area: One domain up to 16 6-mile hexes or 1 24-mile hex

effects.summary: Unleashes a divine catastrophe that devastates a target domain.
effects.effect: The specific form depends on the deity, but the damage procedure is the same regardless of form.
Can affect both the domain and any urban settlement within the domain; treat each separately.

targets.requirement: Caster must have either visited the target domain or personally met the target domain's ruler.

limits.limit: Cannot be cast against the domain of a ruler of the same alignment and religion as the divine caster.

procedure.step: Begin the ritual; ominous signs and portents intensify as completion approaches.
Before completion, a miracle or wish can avert the cataclysm, or the ritual can be stopped by killing the caster.
If not averted, when the ritual completes, each affected stronghold and each affected urban settlement loses 3d6x1000gp in value per 1,000 families in the domain or settlement.
Each affected domain or settlement also loses 1d10x100 families per 1,000 families.
If remaining stronghold value or urban investment is too low to sustain the population, excess population immediately scatters.
The affected domain makes an immediate domain morale roll with a -4 penalty.

special.rule: Usually reserved for punishing terrible heresies or during holy wars.
Special component is always divine power.

effects.summary: Permanently drains one Hit Die or life level from the target.

special.rule: Used to create swords of life drinking.

spell.name: Forbiddance
spell.area: Up to 100 cubic feet per caster level

effects.summary: Seals an area against extradimensional beings and extradimensional travel.
effects.effect: No dimension door or teleportation spell or spell effect can enter, leave, or function within the area.
No summoned creatures can be conjured within the area by any means.
effects.damage: Creatures entering with alignment one degree different take 6d6 damage.
Creatures entering with alignment two degrees different take 12d6 damage.

duration_rules.rule: Lasts until dispelled by the caster or a higher-level spellcaster.

targets.target: Reflective device such as a mirror, crystal, or polished jewel

effects.summary: Creates an extradimensional compartment that traps the first qualifying reflected creature.
effects.effect: The first human-sized or smaller creature that sees its reflection must save or be trapped bodily with all clothing and equipment.
Trapped creatures do not age, breathe, or eat and are completely powerless.
Anyone holding the device may call the prisoner's reflection to the surface and converse with the prisoner.

duration_rules.rule: Ends if the device is broken or is subjected to dispel evil or dispel magic by a higher-level spellcaster.
When the spell ends, the trapped creature is freed.

special.rule: Used to create mirrors of life trapping.

effects.summary: Makes the touched creature 10 years younger.
effects.effect: Can reverse natural aging and aging from magic or creature effects.
Age cannot be reduced below 15, or mid-adolescence for non-humans.

limits.limit: Each application carries a cumulative 1% chance that all previous age reversals from longevity effects, including potions, are negated.

reversed_form.name: decrepitude

effects.summary: Ages the victim by 10 years.

saving_throw.rule: No saving throw against the aging itself.
Creatures with short lifespans, such as humans, must save versus Death or die from the shock of sudden aging.

reversed_form.special: Used to create staffs of withering.

special.rule: Used to create potions of longevity.

effects.summary: Can accomplish the effects of any other spell, or comparable effects, through divine intercession.
effects.effect: May reverse events, restore the dead to life, heal an entire army, or teleport an entire group to any location without error.

limits.limit: Fulfillment depends on the deity's approval, not precise wording.
Miracles that do not advance the deity's agenda go unfulfilled.
Unless obviously self-sacrificing, a granted miracle subjects the caster to a quest.

special.rule: Special component is always divine power.

targets.target: Reflective device such as a mirror, crystal, or polished jewel

effects.summary: Places a dweomer that creates a hostile duplicate of the first qualifying creature that sees its reflection.
effects.effect: The first human-sized or smaller creature seeing its reflection is confronted by a duplicate with all possessions and powers, including magic.
The duplicate has an opposite and inimical disposition and attacks immediately and relentlessly.
When either the original or the duplicate is defeated or destroyed, the duplicate and its items disappear completely.

special.rule: Used to create mirrors of opposition.

effects.summary: Creates a spreading pestilence that devastates population and morale.

procedure.step: Each month, the plague affects one additional adjacent 6-mile hex.
Each affected hex loses 1d10 families per 100 families each month.
Any die that rolls a 10 explodes: roll again and add the new result, repeating for additional 10s.
Any time a plague-affected domain must make a morale roll, reduce its morale score by 1 before making the roll.

effects.summary: Heals permanent wounds and regenerates lost body parts.
effects.effect: Repairs severed parts, broken bones, ruined organs, and other permanent wounds.
effects.healing: Cures 4d8 damage +1 point per caster level.
effects.effect: Removes any requirement for bed rest.
Unlike restore life and limb, does not require a roll on Tampering With Mortality.

procedure.step: If severed members are present and touching the creature, regeneration is instantly complete.

reversed_form.name: withering

effects.summary: Deals damage and inflicts a permanent wound chosen by the caster.
effects.damage: Deals 4d8 damage +1 point per caster level.
effects.effect: May ruin lips and tongue (5/6 on Mortal Wounds), destroy eyes (5/5), wither one leg (10/4) or arm (10/3), or damage hearts and lungs (15/1).

reversed_form.special: Used to create staffs of withering.

effects.summary: Reflects incoming spells back against their casters.
effects.effect: The protected creature is unaffected by reflected spells.
The recipient's own spells can still affect the recipient.
Allied spells are also reflected even if beneficial.

limits.limit: Affects spells only, not monster powers or magical effects that are not spells.

scaling.rule: Reflects one spell per level of the ritual caster.

duration_rules.rule: Ends when dispel magic is applied or when the maximum number of spells has been turned.

interactions.rule: If two creatures protected by spell turning cast at one another, the spell bounces between them until one of the rituals ends.

special.rule: Used to create rings of spell turning.

effects.summary: Summons an efreeti to serve and obey the summoner.
effects.effect: Service ends after 33⅔ days, when it grants a wish, when slain, or when dispelled.
Efreet resent being summoned and will twist orders wherever possible.

special.rule: Used to create efreeti bottles.

effects.summary: Places the subject into temporal stasis.
effects.effect: Time ceases to flow for the subject.
The subject does not age, its condition does not change, and no force or effect can harm it.

saving_throw.condition: Allowed if the target is unwilling.

duration_rules.rule: Persists until dispelled by the caster or a higher-level spellcaster, or until a condition set at casting is met.
A common ending condition is a particular alignment of the stars or outer planes.

targets.requirement: Can only be cast in a place of death such as a cemetery, catacomb, or battleground.

effects.summary: Raises a vast undead army from the dead in the area.
effects.effect: Creates a number of Hit Dice of skeletons or zombies equal to 200 times the caster's level, limited by the number of dead present.
Whether the army is skeletons or zombies depends on the condition of the corpses.
Skeleton HD equals the creature's HD in life, excluding class levels; human and demi-human skeletons are always 1 HD.
Zombies have one more HD than the creature had in life.

duration_rules.rule: Normally lasts one week.
May be made permanent by sprinkling 1 vial of unholy water per Hit Die on each undead.
If made permanent, the undead remain until destroyed or dispelled.

interactions.rule: If cast in a sinkhole of evil, calculate effects as if the caster were one or more levels higher than actual.
